text: Johnny, get your gun, get your gun, get your gun. Johnny, show the hun, you're a son of the gun. Hoist the flag and let her fly. Yankees, do, do, do or die. Pack your little kit, show your rift, do your bit. Yankees, do the rank from the towns and the tanks. Make your mother proud of you and the old
